questions.question: Which nations are addressed in the oracles of Jeremiah 49?
options: Egypt, Assyria, Babylon, Persia, and Media
Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar, and Elam
questions.answer: Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar, and Elam

questions.question: What does God say about Edom's pride?
options: Its humble and lowly spirit will spare it from harm
Its cause is just, and it will surely be vindicated
Its high walls and rocky heights will keep it safe
The terror Edom inspired and its pride have deceived it
questions.answer: The terror Edom inspired and its pride have deceived it

questions.question: Jeremiah 49 says God will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites afterward.
Concerning Edom: the pride of your heart has _____ you.
Damascus has become _____; she turns to flee, and panic has seized her.
